capabilities: Previews Markdown in a WeChat article layout
Copies standard or WeChat-ready rich text
Converts text tables to PNG images
Renders Mermaid diagrams in the preview
disambiguation: It does not upload anything to WeChat; copy actions only write rich text and table images to the system clipboard for manual pasting.
extras: Freemium: preview, standard copy, themes and path copy are free; WeChat copy and table image copy need a paid license code. License verification is offline, stored in the vault's data.json, not device-bound and can be forwarded; the author warns local code can be modified, so signature checks do not prevent cracking. Desktop only; source is private with builds via GitHub Actions; the old test version uses a different plugin ID and separate config.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to lay notes out as WeChat articles or to copy WeChat-ready rich text and table images.

relations.evidence: the shop handles payment and license delivery

requires.name: Program Shop license code for WeChat copy and table image copy

summary: WeChat article previewer that renders Markdown with themes and typography and copies rich text or table PNGs to the clipboard.
